title: Engineers Cadence Leads Bulletin - 2026-02-16
content:
Purpose: quick cross-team cadence capture to make the next two sprint boundaries less noisy. Audience = engineering leads + product+SRE. Tone = tactical, callouts, owners.

Attendees: Priya (host), Marco (platform), Sofia (serving-runtime), Liam (observability), Janelle (private-deploys), Devon (solutions). Several notes pulled from Slack thread #lead-weekly and pre-reads.

1) Top-line priorities (30s each)
- Platform: finish capacity pricing experiment (A/B on batching + quantization profile) by end of sprint. Target metric: 18% lower p99 token cost for typical chat workload. Owner: Marco. Linked: ENG-4023.
- Serving runtime: new KV-cache eviction prototype rolled to canary (10% traffic). Early signal shows 6% latency improvement at 512-step sequences. Owner: Sofia. PR: runtime/pull/987.
- Observability: tracing retention ETL hit missing fields for private tenants — investigation in progress. Owner: Liam. Blocker: missing logs from VPC agents (SRE-211).
- Private Deploys: airgap packaging beta delayed by infra security sign-off. Janelle to escalate with Security by Thu.
- Solutions: two pilot customers requesting per-route SLAs and route-level batching config. Devon to scope for Dedicated offering.

2) Decisions made
- Move forward with capacity pricing A/B experiment; greenlight to spend up to $8k in experiment infra. (Decision: yes; Marco accountable).
- KV-cache eviction changes will be gated by 48-hour canary metrics threshold (p95 and p99). If regression >5% for median latency, revert. (Sofia to enact).

3) Blockers & escalations
- Security sign-off backlog: Private packaging blocked on legal/security checklist item (encryption policy mismatch). Action: Janelle to drop a 1:1 with Priya and Legal on 2026-02-17.
- Observability missing fields: SRE needs additional IAM permissions for VPC agents. Action: Liam to file SRE-211 with detailed permission diff and target date 2026-02-19.
- Hiring: platform infra hire offer accepted but start date slipped to Apr; short-term capacity gap for release engineering. Action: Priya to reprioritize tickets and consider contractor for March.

4) Risks & mitigations
- Risk: aggressive batching configs reduce model quality for some customer prompts. Mitigation: run prompt-level evaluation harness on canary traffic and hold rollback window open for 24 hours. Owner: Marco + Applied ML.
- Risk: Private deploy packaging miscommunication increases remediation time. Mitigation: one-pager checklist and weekly sync between Security/Product/Private deploys. Janelle to draft.

5) Tactical lanes (who does what next 7 days)
- Marco: finalize experiment config, set cost caps, notify finance by 2026-02-18.
- Sofia: monitor canary KV metrics, run targeted prompts for quality regression, report 2026-02-20.
- Liam: submit SRE-211 with logs sample, coordinate IAM change with infra team by 2026-02-19.
- Janelle: escalate encryption policy question, draft packaging checklist, and book cross-org sync by 2026-02-18.
- Devon: prepare SLA scoping doc and initial pricing sketch for Dedicated by 2026-02-22.
- Priya: reallocate release-engineering sprint capacity and confirm contractor options by 2026-02-19.

6) Quick wins shared
- Observability: new query template reduced dashboard render for latency heatmaps by ~40% (Liam).
- Serving: small GC tuning reduced tail latencies in canary by ~2% (Sofia).

7) Follow-ups & calendar
- Next leadership cadence: 2026-02-23, 10:00-10:45am PT. Pre-read due 24h before: one-pager with 3 metrics + 2 asks.
- Action tracker: owners update JIRA tickets with short note and completion date before next sync.

Notes to self (informal):
- Keep experiment spend visible to finance; they want weekly updates.
- Reminder: surface any privacy customer asks to Legal ASAP.

Raw decisions / action log (for cut and paste):
- Marco to run capacity pricing A/B (ENG-4023) - due 2026-02-23.
- Sofia to revert KV changes if canary regresses >5% - ongoing, check 2026-02-20.
- Liam to file SRE-211 with IAM diff - due 2026-02-19.
- Janelle to escalate packaging policy + draft checklist - due 2026-02-18.
- Priya to confirm contractor / reprioritize release tickets - due 2026-02-19.

End of notes. Short, actionable, please update your ticket or drop a one-liner in #lead-weekly if you need a slot for deep dive.
